sentences.japanese: そこで私たちを待っている幸福が、私たちが望むような幸福ではないかもしれない。
sentences.english: It may be that the happiness awaiting us is not at all the sort of happiness we would want.

sentences.japanese: カーチャは無政府主義者であったことを否認し、政治体制に変革をもたらすことを望んだだけで、破壊しようとしたわけではない、と主張し続けた。
sentences.english: Denying she was an anarchist, Katja maintained she wished only to make changes in our government, not to destroy it.

sentences.japanese: 君の夢一杯のビジネスプラン、絵に描いた餅にならんことを切に望むよ。
sentences.english: This business plan of yours seems almost too optimistic. All I can say is I hope it's more than just wishful thinking.

sentences.japanese: 君が望まないなら、彼の忠告に従う必要はない。
sentences.english: It is not necessary for you to take his advice if you don't want to.

sentences.japanese: 君が早く病気から回復されるよう、心から望んでおります。
sentences.english: I sincerely hope that you will soon recover from your illness.
